title: Vehicle Body 3DOF Longitudinal
text: 3DOF rigid vehicle body to calculate longitudinal, vertical, and pitch motion, 11 inputs, 4 outputs, {Ground interaction type} sets Axle attachment to the vehicle Grade; {External forces} sets the fExt input port, {External moments} sets the mExt input port, {Air temperature} sets the airTemp input port, {Number of wheels on front axle, NF} sets the front wheel count, {Number of wheels on rear axle, NR} sets the rear wheel count, {Mass, m} sets the vehicle mass, {Horizontal distance from CG to front axle, a} sets the front axle distance, {Horizontal distance from CG to rear axle, b} sets the rear axle distance, {CG height above axles, h} sets the height, {Longitudinal drag coefficient, Cd} sets the drag .3, {Frontal area, Af} sets the area, {Initial position, x_o} sets the position, {Initial velocity, xdot_o} sets the velocity, {Longitudinal lift coefficient, Cl} sets the lift .1, {Initial vertical position, z_o} sets the position -.35, {Initial vertical velocity, zdot_o} sets the velocity, {Inertia, Iyy} sets the about body y -axis, {Longitudinal drag pitch moment, Cpm} sets the drag coefficient .1, {Initial pitch angle, theta_o} sets the pitch, {Initial angular velocity, q_o} sets the pitch velocity, {Front axle stiffness force data, FskF} sets the force, {Front axle displacement data, dzsF} sets the displacement, {Front axle damping force data, FsbF} sets the damping force, {Front axle velocity data, dzdotsF} sets the velocity, {Rear axle stiffness force data, FskR} sets the force, {Rear axle displacement data, dzsR} sets the displacement, {Rear axle damping force data, FsbR} sets the damping force, {Rear axle velocity data, dzdotsR} sets the velocity, {Absolute air pressure, Pabs} sets the pressure, {Air temperature, Tair} sets the ambient air temperature and {Gravitational acceleration, g} sets the gravity. Values come from the instance.
